title: “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” — James 4:6
paragraphs: “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” — James 4:6

I’ve noticed something about my heart:
Sometimes I want to be right more than I want to be changed.

God seems less impressed with my clever arguments
and more responsive to a humble posture.
Grace doesn’t argue back. It lands where humility makes room.
"Lord, help me trade my raised eyebrow for an open heart today."
